title: 一刀不斷
subject: an office worker whose secret hobby is peeling an apple in one unbroken strip, practising every night on supermarket apples to beat his own record of two point three metres while his girlfriend is made to eat every apple
caption: Mandarin new wave guitar pop in the style of early-1980s angular guitar bands. Clean chorus-flanged electric guitar playing choppy staccato riffs and a jittery hook, jumpy melodic bass guitar playing nervous eighth-note runs, tight drum kit with crisp snare backbeat and ticking hi-hat. Dry, tight, angular studio production. Male tenor vocal, bright, slightly nervy and clearly sung. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 146 BPM, E major. Jittery, deadpan-funny, bouncy mood. No autotune, no rap, no synthesizer, no accordion, no brass, no ballad tempo.
lyrics:
[Intro - choppy staccato guitar riff, jumpy bass, tight drums]

[Verse 1]
下班回家關上門
桌上一顆紅蘋果
削皮刀在燈下閃
今晚要破兩米三

[Pre-Chorus]
手腕慢慢地轉
呼吸不要亂

[Chorus]
一刀不斷 一刀不斷
果皮垂到我的腳邊
別說話 別打噴嚏
這一圈是我的戰場

[Verse 2]
她吃到第一百顆
說她牙齒會發酸
我說再陪我一晚
明天換成水梨好嗎

[Pre-Chorus]
兩米二 兩米三
我閉上眼睛

[Chorus]
一刀不斷 一刀不斷
果皮繞過整個客廳
她鼓掌 我才敢喘
這一刀是為你削的

[Outro - clean chorus guitar and bass, last staccato chord]
蘋果給你 皮留給我
